# SimpleUI (SUI)

> SimpleUI is a small reactive UI language and compiler: a `.sui` file becomes a self-contained web app or a desktop executable. This file is the compact discovery index for LLMs and coding agents.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical coding-agent guide - workflow, security rules, repo map, commands, task routing.
- [GIT_WORKFLOW.md](GIT_WORKFLOW.md): Mandatory commit policy for agents, baseline tag and restore commands.
- [docs/INDEX.md](docs/INDEX.md): Human-friendly documentation map and task-based navigation.
- [docs/AGENT_RECIPES.md](docs/AGENT_RECIPES.md): Code patterns for local forms/tables, drag and drop, remote APIs, CRUD, polling, desktop capabilities, spreadsheets and iframes.
- [docs/GUI_EDITOR.md](docs/GUI_EDITOR.md): Designer drag and drop, application DnD properties, file drops and native pickers.
- [docs/manifest.json](docs/manifest.json): Machine-readable index (documents, sections, tags, invariants, recipes).

## Language and API

- [docs/API_REFERENCE.md](docs/API_REFERENCE.md): Essential syntax, drag and drop, tables, iframe attributes, security and CLI.
- [docs/BUILTINS.md](docs/BUILTINS.md): Built-in functions that need no import.
- [docs/STDLIB.md](docs/STDLIB.md): `http`, `ws`, `fs`, `exec`, `json`, the core `table` API and the desktop `dialog` picker.
- [SPEC.md](SPEC.md): Normative language, compiler, runtime and CLI contracts.

## Security

- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): Threat model, escaping, CSS/classes, SSRF, iframe hardening, bridge, residual risks.
- [examples/security/README.md](examples/security/README.md): Runnable untrusted-input examples.

## Examples

- [examples/README.md](examples/README.md): Index of runnable examples.
- [examples/table_data.sui](examples/table_data.sui): Table data and CSV import/export.
- [examples/richtext_editor/README.md](examples/richtext_editor/README.md): Rich text editor with JSON model, formatting, tables/images/links, plugins and JSON/HTML/Markdown/XML import/export.
- [examples/menu_bar.sui](examples/menu_bar.sui): Configurable menu bar with submenus, links and actions.
- [examples/tabs.sui](examples/tabs.sui): Working tab set with clickable panels and keyboard navigation.
- [examples/pages/README.md](examples/pages/README.md): Multi-page navigation with `navigate()`, shared state and a complete walkthrough.
- [examples/modal.sui](examples/modal.sui): Configurable modal dialog with preset buttons and `modal.open()`.
- [examples/drag_drop.sui](examples/drag_drop.sui): Reorder rows and drop files/folders.
- [examples/file_picker.sui](examples/file_picker.sui): Native file/directory dialog with `pickFiles`.
- [examples/file_analyzer/README.md](examples/file_analyzer/README.md): Upload selected/dropped files to a Go backend and render type analysis in a table.
- [examples/desktop_picker.sui](examples/desktop_picker.sui): Native desktop file/folder picker with `dialog.pickFile` and `pickDirectory`.
- [examples/users/app.sui](examples/users/app.sui): Remote JSON API into a table.
- [examples/spreadsheet_table/README.md](examples/spreadsheet_table/README.md): XLSX/ODS conversion.

## Automation

- `simpleui docs --agent` — compact context bundle.
- `simpleui docs --json` — full manifest.
- `simpleui docs --read <id>` — one document.
- `simpleui docs --search <term>` — search by title, tag or summary.
- `simpleui docs --full` — all embedded documentation.
- `simpleui check app.sui --json` — parse/typecheck with structured diagnostics.
- `simpleui mcp` — MCP tools, `sui://docs/<path>` resources and prompts.
